summary: Changed generated repositories' quality:fallow script to check dead code, duplication, and complexity against identity-matched recorded hits in fallow-health-recorded-hits.json, added quality:fallow:record-hits, and enabled complexity-cyclomatic, complexity-cognitive, and complexity-file-lines as errors in .fallowrc.json (limit: a recorded function that gets more complex is not caught).
action: After a Template upgrade, run bun run quality:fallow:record-hits once to record existing complexity findings in fallow-health-recorded-hits.json; bun run check then passes on existing findings and fails on new complexity findings.
